profile.headline: Data & Software Engineer | Analytics Engineering & MarTech Systems
profile.summary:
I am a Data and Software Engineer with 8 years of experience across the digital marketing and data landscape. My career path hasn’t been a straight line, it’s been an evolution. I started as an intern writing social media calendars, moved into running SEM and paid social campaigns, mastered website tagging and testing, and eventually fell down the reporting rabbit hole. Today, I build the data pipelines and architectures that ensure that reporting is actually reliable and actionable.

Right now, I’m focused on building ELT pipelines to bring in CRM, website, and marketing data for retail clients within a modern marketing analytics platform. My day-to-day is a mix of focused engineering, firing up my IDE to update dbt models and Dagster pipelines, building new data quality checks, and high-level strategy. I spend a lot of time translating complex product capabilities for non-technical stakeholders, integrating new clients, and scoping and developing new features.

In my free time... what free time? I am a hobby collector! Whether it’s chasing podiums on my bike, obsessing over pizza from scratch, shooting film, refurbishing iPods (jeez, I really am a millennial), I’m driven by the process of figuring out how systems work. I love learning new things, and challenging myself. How else do you stumble into data engineering?

That hobby collector spirit is exactly why I’ve thrived for over 6 years in the agency world. I enjoy wearing multiple hats and the pressure of charting new paths to deliver on big contracts. To me, winning is about consistency; and my role in that win is providing the steady, reliable data infrastructure that my teammates and clients need to make big moves.

If any of that interests you, please reach out. I am always happy to connect with fellow engineers, marketing geeks, and hobby collectors!

positions.title: Data & Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Acted as technical lead for concurrent end-to-end data integration projects, managing the design, implementation, and QA of pipelines that ingest and transform CRM, ad-platform and web analytics data into model-ready datasets.
• Orchestrated complex ETL/ELT workflows using dbt and Dagster within GCP and Databricks, migrating legacy analytics workloads to a modern lakehouse platform through automated, template-driven deployment.
• Designed and built a Python-based Databricks dashboard template generator that standardized configuration for analytics dashboards, significantly reducing time to delivery by reducing manual setup, and speeding QA and data quality checks during new client onboarding.
• Enhanced the reliability of high-impact datasets for Media Mix Modeling (MMM) by implementing robust testing, monitoring, and automated validation checks that reduced edge-case failures.
• Partnered with Data Science and Analytics teams to architect SQL semantic layers and data contracts, ensuring that upstream pipelines effectively supported complex time-series modeling and downstream visualization needs.

positions.title: Solution Architect
positions.description:
• Supported technical onboarding for a media mix model's website tracking and crm data components, working directly with clients to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.
• Refined onboarding processes by developing repeatable steps with clear requirements and sign-off. Adding to our team knowledge base with FAQ docs for stakeholders, and on-call playbooks for routine pipeline failures.
• Developed actionable Looker Studio dashboards for analyst teams, enabling seamless comparisons between first-party data platform metrics and external sources like Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics.
• Investigated data pipeline failures in Dagster and BigQuery, working closely with Data Engineering teams to resolve issues, creating detailed break-fix stories for improvement.
• Deployed new Dagster orchestrated dbt models to Big Query and Databricks to support website data monitoring and BI dashboards.

positions.title: Sr. Web Analytics Specialist
positions.description:
• Acted as the lead digital marketing specialist for VSP.com; in this role I leveraged screen recordings, website A/B testing, and Google Analytics data, to support web initiatives and uncover optimization opportunities
• Created custom dashboards with web data in Google Data Studio for users at every level of the enterprise
• Presented website analysis reports for key site sections, dissecting inefficiencies and bottlenecks while recommending actionable solutions, to market managers and senior leaders
• Trained teams and individuals in tools like Google Analytics, Data Studio, Google Ads, and Facebook Ads
• Expanded web data collection by adding new website tags and data layer variables using Google Tag Manager

positions.title: Web Analytics Specialist
positions.description:
• Proactively consulted with business partners across the enterprise and among team members to identify web intelligence topics, providing insightful and actionable analysis in support of decision making
• Worked alongside market managers, UX designers and digital analysts to define tag management solutions
• Completed ad-hoc reporting requests with actionable analysis for market managers, strategists and leadership
• Collaborated with traditional marketing analysts, enhancing member and provider web data for improved segmentation and ROI analysis, synchronizing company CDP and Salesforce data with web data
• Coordinated with agency partners, installing campaign tracking, and improving website engagement visibility

positions.title: Digital Account Manager
positions.description:
• Managed Google Ads and Bing campaigns for paid search, display, and video
• Developed and implemented campaign strategies for lead focused clients
• Improved website tracking for key clients by recommending and managing Google Analytics events and campaign tracking
• Built comprehensive Google Data Studio reporting dashboards and reports for digital media analysis

positions.title: Sr. Digital Coordinator
positions.description:
• Developed reporting systems for statewide digital campaigns, starting with link tagging for complete Google Analytics tracking that seamlessly fed into Google Data Studio reports.
• Implemented new reporting methods by leveraging automation through APIs with tools like Supermetrics.
• Crafted visual stories with data to clearly communicate results to clients.
• AdWords management from copy and keywords to optimizations and conversions, including Spanish language campaigns.

positions.title: Digital Coordinator
positions.description:
• Developed ongoing social media content calendars for client and internal accounts, schedules content on appropriate platforms and compiles reports
• Supported digital and social media advertising campaigns, including ad trafficking, URL tagging, optimizations and reporting in Google Data Studio
• Leveraged Google Analytics to track ad campaign performance and attribute increased website activity to both online and offline ad sources
• Worked closely with internal teams, including creative, media, public relations, social marketing and client services, to create data driven recommendations for launching and optimizing digital campaigns across channels

positions.title: Digital Intern
positions.description:
• Tracked and reported on KPIs tracked in Google Analytics to create a complete picture of our social media efforts
• Used Google Analytics to perform website audits and draft strategic plans for improvement that increased organic website traffic and user engagement
• Drafted social media content calendars for clients in different industries
• Wrote and optimized AdWords campaigns with quality keyword lists and engaging ad copy
• Managed and developed Facebook ad campaigns with demographic and location targeting

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed website improvements for SEO; ranking a previously unsearchable domain
• Tracked user interactions with Google Analytics to audit site content and improve high traffic website pages
• Automated AdWords reporting with custom dashboards in Google Data Studio to create easily digestible and actionable decision from key performance indicators

positions.title: Prairie Elementary Coach
positions.description:
• Coached soccer games and exercises with a STEM twist to over 100 elementary school students 
• Facilitated a fun and safe environment for kids to work as part of a team and build confidence, in the classroom and on the soccer field
• Established relationships between Coast 2 Coast and the school administration to run a tailored program that met the school's needs and desired outcomes

positions.title: Office of Public Affairs Intern
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
• Provided administrative support for the Office of Public Affairs
• Composed articles featuring the ACS summer intern staff for the company's internal newsletter
• Investigated and compiled background information on chemistry topics for our Media Communications team
• Monitored and logged member activity into excel for the Society Communications team
• Supported our science writers by tracking and logging the activity of ACS press releases in the media

volunteerExperiences.description: Successfully led student outreach initiatives at AAF Sacramento Chapter. Provided mentorship, organized workshops, and facilitated networking opportunities to help students discover the Sacramento advertising industry.
Led the AMA's California State University, Sacramento chapter. Managed a club of 30 active members, organized weekly meetings, spearheaded new member recruitment, and oversaw club finances.
